name: Meat Loaf
subtitle: From L&L’s friend Jennah
equipment: Greased bread pan, ramekins for excess

steps.title: Sauté the onion and garlic
steps.body: Sauté in medium pan until onions sweated: **1 Tbsp butter**, **1 large onion, minced** and **3 cloves garlic, minced**.

steps.title: Mix the milk mixture
steps.body: Mix together in a separate bowl: **1 cup milk** and **1 cup bread crumbs**.

steps.title: Mix the meat loaf
steps.body: In a large bowl, mix together the spices, then add all these ingredients plus the milk mixture and sautéed onions and garlic: **2 lb ground beef**, **1 Tbsp all purpose seasoning**, **1 Tbsp Italian seasoning**, **1 Tbsp Worcestershire sauce**, **1 Tbsp salt**, **2 tsp black pepper**, **2 tsp chilli flakes**, **¼ cup ketchup** and **2 eggs**.

steps.title: Bake the loaf
steps.body: Bake in a greased bread pan at 350°F for 45 minutes. Excess can be baked in ramekins in less time.

steps.title: Make the glaze
steps.body: Mix to make glaze (this makes about 50% more glaze than you need): **½ cup brown sugar**, **¾ cup ketchup**, **1 Tbsp onion powder**, **1 Tbsp garlic powder** and **¼ cup white vinegar**.

steps.title: Glaze and finish
steps.body: Spread glaze on top of loaf while still hot then bake for 15-20 more minutes at 350°F, until internal temperature is 160°F.
